items.title: Henselization and strict henselization do not change the dimension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a local ring and its henselization and strict henselization have the same dimension, and the proof is a 22-line argument that separates the two inequalities. The inequality in one direction comes from going down along the faithfully flat map to the strict henselization; the other direction uses the description of the strict henselization as a directed colimit of rings each of which is a localisation of an etale algebra over the base, shows that any finite chain of primes in the colimit is the image of a chain in some stage, and then applies the equality of dimensions for etale extensions. The colimit argument is the substance, and it is displayed.
